from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,time
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from urllib.parse import urljoin
import requests,pdfplumber
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
root=Path.cwd()
d=root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_coupon_jan2024_source_qualification_v1'
sources=d/'sources'
rows=json.loads((d/'合格固定利率付息券公告候选.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['rows']
receipt=json.loads((d/'source_receipts.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert not (d/'originals_acquisition_completed.json').exists(),'原件已经完成，不能重启采集'
items=[]
base='https://fiscaldata.treasury.gov/static-data/published-reports/auctions-query/announcements/'
for row in rows:
    for field in ['xml_filenm_announcemt','pdf_filenm_announcemt']:
        filename=row[field]
        assert filename and '/' not in filename and '\\' not in filename
        items.append((filename,base+filename,sources/filename))
soup=BeautifulSoup((sources/'20231101财政部季度安排.html').read_bytes(),'html.parser')
(sources/'20231101财政部季度安排.txt').write_text(soup.get_text('\n',strip=True),encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
imgs=[img for img in soup.find_all('img') if 'anticipated auction sizes' in img.get('alt','').lower()]
assert len(imgs)==1,'季度计划表图不唯一'
image_url=urljoin('https://home.treasury.gov',imgs[0]['src'])
items += [('prior_quarter_plan_table',image_url,sources/'20231101季度计划表.PNG'),
          ('prior_release_clock_context','https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/USTREAS/bulletins/378754d?reqfrom=share',sources/'20231030季度借款及公布时钟.html')]
assert len(items)<=24+3
def now():
    return datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
def fetch(item):
    name,url,path=item
    assert not path.exists(),'原件已经存在，不覆盖'
    attempts=[]
    for attempt in range(1,3):
        try:
            r=requests.get(url,timeout=(10,30),headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 HistoricalResearch/1.0'})
            attempts.append({'attempt':attempt,'at':now(),'http_status':r.status_code})
            if r.status_code==200:
                path.write_bytes(r.content)
                return {'name':name,'url':url,'source_path':str(path.relative_to(root)).replace('\\','/'),'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(r.content).hexdigest(),'bytes':len(r.content),'retrieved_at':now(),'status':'RECEIVED','attempts':attempts}
            if r.status_code in [403,429]:
                break
        except requests.RequestException as e:
            attempts.append({'attempt':attempt,'at':now(),'error_type':type(e).__name__,'error':str(e)[:200]})
        if attempt<2:
            time.sleep(1)
    return {'name':name,'url':url,'status':'NOT_RECEIVED','attempts':attempts}
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) as pool:
    received=list(pool.map(fetch,items))
receipt['items'].extend(received)
receipt['updated_at']=now()
(d/'source_receipts.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
missing=[x for x in received if x['status']!='RECEIVED']
if missing:
    print('未取得原件',json.dumps(missing,ensure_ascii=False))
else:
    pdfs=[]
    for row in rows:
        p=sources/row['pdf_filenm_announcemt']
        with pdfplumber.open(p) as pdf:
            texts=[page.extract_text() or '' for page in pdf.pages]
        p.with_suffix('.txt').write_text('\n\n'.join(texts),encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
        pdfs.append({'cusip':row['cusip'],'pdf':p.name,'pages':len(texts),'first_text':texts[0][:500]})
    print('各券原件',json.dumps(pdfs,ensure_ascii=False))
    context_soup=BeautifulSoup((sources/'20231030季度借款及公布时钟.html').read_bytes(),'html.parser')
    text=context_soup.get_text('\n',strip=True)
    (sources/'20231030季度借款及公布时钟.txt').write_text(text,encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
    selected=[x.strip() for x in text.splitlines() if '8:30' in x or 'Wednesday' in x or 'October 30' in x or '11/01' in x or '10/30' in x]
    print('季度公布时钟原文',json.dumps(selected,ensure_ascii=False)[:2000])
    (d/'originals_acquisition_completed.json').write_text(json.dumps({'at':now(),'securities':len(rows),'announcement_files':14,'quarterly_additional_sources':3,'all_received':True,'pdf_pages':sum(x['pages'] for x in pdfs),'new_model_fits':0,'new_accounts':0},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
